title: Court Attention at All Costs
coreMove: Create controlled distinctiveness and keep varying it before attention goes cold
sourcePressure: visibility as power, the danger of being lost in the crowd, and the use of distinctiveness and mystery to hold attention without fixing the wrong reputation.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: chasing any attention even bad attention
